RULES.A: returned conditionId must equal requested; else LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE/CONDITION_ID_MISMATCH
RULES.B: selected_token_id must be in clobTokenIds; else INVALID_TOKEN_IDENTITY, never LOSS
RULES.C: WIN iff selected token is the single winning token; LOSS iff selected token valid and opposite token wins; OPEN iff matched market not closed
RULES.D: null lookup, malformed response, closed without single >=0.99 winner => LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE; never OPEN, never inferred
